fusions.name: Sleight of Pod
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back. Flicks a spore that deals 7 damage with a 30% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Light Fingers
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Snatches with a spore thread up to 6 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Wrong Pocket
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Lucky Break
fusions.desc: When 8 seconds pass without a critical hit, 25% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
